summary: Full end-to-end testing (backend + frontend) of C213 PID Dashboard — Grupo 9. All 10 backend pytest tests pass and all 3 frontend tabs behave per spec. Smith identification values match PRD (K=0.7471, tau=33.63, theta=9.06, MSE=0.022). ZN/ITAE tuning returns the expected PID parameters. Dataset auto-loads on first visit with a 'Dataset do Grupo 9 carregado' toast. Chart markers (28.3%, 63.2%, theta) are rendered, and Tab 3 comparative chart shows open-loop vs closed-loop. PNG export buttons exist on chart components.
critical_code_review_comments: control_engine.simulate_closed_loop: redundant dy assignment (first dy computed then immediately overwritten). Cosmetic only, but should remove the dead line for clarity.
server.py: logger is created AFTER CORSMiddleware is added — minor ordering issue. Does not affect functionality.
backend/datasets/Dataset_Grupo9_c213.mat and /app/datasets/Dataset_Grupo9_c213.mat are duplicated — consider a single source of truth.
seed_data_creation: None (default dataset Dataset_Grupo9_c213.mat already bundled in /app/backend/datasets/)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/, /api/dataset/default, /api/dataset/upload, /api/identify, /api/tune (zn+itae), /api/simulate all verified via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest). Frontend was UI-tested via Playwright: verified (a) auto-loading dataset+toast, (b) Smith identification panel with K/tau/theta/EQM and G(s) formula, (c) Tab 2 ZN→ITAE switch re-simulating and updating Kp/Ti/Td and metric cards (tr=10.42s, ts=30.15s, Mp=2.49%, ess=0.018 for ITAE), (d) Tab 3 metrics grid and comparative chart with markers, (e) 2 export-PNG buttons rendered. All data-testid selectors from the review request are present and working.
